# Geo-AHU

Public Geo-AHU calculator and EnergyPlus simulation interface.

Primary public simulation URL:
https://raj607261-sudo.github.io/geo-ahu-energyplus-runner/simulation/

The site presents Geo-AHU cold-storage design inputs and EnergyPlus-based comparison outputs for conventional versus geothermal-assisted refrigeration concepts.

Crawling and indexing are allowed.
